locator.section: 8.2 Product stability (stepwise retro-Diels-Alder of the 4-vinylcyclohexene molecular ion)

evidence.curator_note: First alpha-cleavage (ring opening) of the stepwise retro-Diels-Alder of the 4-vinylcyclohexene molecular ion (C8H12+., m/z 108) -- the vinyl analog of eq 4.31/4.32 (R = vinyl instead of R = phenyl). ARC COUNT: the book draws 0 reaction fishhooks for this step; the precursor is drawn as the [M]+. bracket (top-left) and the step is indicated ONLY by the alpha-labelled straight arrow. All three moves <1,2,3> are implicit, required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Move <1> = the odd electron on the pi-ionized ring alkene carbon (map 6) into the forming C6=C7 pi bond; move <2> = one electron of the breaking C2-C7 ring sigma bond into that same forming pi bond; move <3> = the other electron of the C2-C7 bond onto the R-bearing carbon (map 2), its new (allylic) radical site. LOCALIZATION (convention B/C): the text states 'the ring double bond is the ionization site (IE = 8.9 eV, compared with 9.6 eV for the [isolated double bond])', so the radical cation is localized on the two former sp2 RING carbons as C5(+)-C6(.); the neutral C=C of 4-vinylcyclohexene sat between maps 5 and 6. R = vinyl: map 1 = the CH= carbon attached to the ring (map 2), map 8 = the terminal =CH2.

locator.section: 8.2 Product stability (second alpha-cleavage of the symmetric open-ring intermediate)

evidence.curator_note: Second alpha-cleavage on the symmetric ring-opened distonic radical cation: the allylic radical (map 2) drives cleavage of the central C3-C4 bond, giving 1,3-butadiene radical cation (m/z 54) + neutral 1,3-butadiene. ARC COUNT: the book draws 0 reaction fishhooks for this step; the intermediate is drawn as TWO resonance forms joined by the identity/resonance sign (triple-bar), collected by a brace, and the step is indicated ONLY by the alpha-labelled arrow down to products (a)/(b). The curved arcs visible ON the intermediate (one arc + '+' at each left end, one arc + '.' at each right end, drawn in BOTH resonance forms) are allyl-delocalization (resonance) arrows, NOT this step's electron flow. All three moves <1,2,3> are implicit, required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). Move <1> = odd electron (map 2) into the forming C2=C3 pi bond; move <2> = one C3-C4 sigma electron into that same pi bond; move <3> = the other C3-C4 sigma electron onto map 4 (new radical of the departing diene ion). PRODUCTS (a)/(b): the page draws two butadiene radical-cation forms with 'or' between them -- (a) s-cis and (b) s-trans 1,3-butadiene+. (equivalently the endocyclic- vs exocyclic-derived diene ion); for the unsubstituted, symmetric parent both are the same species C4H6+. (m/z 54), so charge-retention and charge-migration channels coincide. This record encodes the C4-C7 (endocyclic-diene) fragment as the ion; the C8/C1/C2/C3 (vinyl+two-ring-carbon) fragment leaves as neutral butadiene. RESONANCE (convention C): the ion is the delocalized butadiene radical cation; it is written here in one localized distonic form, .CH2-CH(+)-CH=CH2 (radical map 4, charge map 5). NO relative intensity is printed for this ion on p.143 (the quantitative data appear as ln([Ar+]/[C4H4+.]) vs IE in Figure 8.3, not as a % on the scheme), so relative_intensity is omitted.

Cross-linked MOD variables (rule_index by_equation '8.6'): IMS_8_6_1, IMS_8_6_2 (step 1, two resonance variants) and IMS_8_6_3, IMS_8_6_4 (step 2, two variants). CROSS-CHECKED against their DFS -- reported as MISMATCH, not asserted as support (see rule_mismatches). (1) Step-1 rules IMS_8_6_1/_2 '[C]1[C]2{=}[C]3[C]4[C]5[C+.]6([C]7{=}[C]8){-}1 >> [C]1[C+]2[C]3[C]4[C]5[C]6[C.]7[C]8' localize the molecular-ion (+.) on the SATURATED, vinyl-bearing ring carbon (map 6) and keep the ring C2=C3 and vinyl C7=C8 double bonds, contradicting the book/text which ionizes the RING double bond (IE 8.9 eV); their open-chain product is a fully single-bonded C8 chain with an isolated carbenium (map 2) and isolated radical (map 7) that DROPS both double bonds, so it is not the book's bis-allylic (allyl-cation ... CH2CH2 ... allyl-radical) symmetric intermediate and is bond-order non-conserving (two pi bonds vanish with nothing formed). (2) Step-2 rules IMS_8_6_3/_4 '[C]1[C+]2[C]3[C]4[C]5[C]6[C.]7[C]8 >> [C]1{=}[C+]2[C]3{=}[C]4.[C]5{=}[C]6[C.]7{=}[C]8' split the chain into a butadien-2-yl CATION (charge on interior map 2) + a butadien-2-yl RADICAL (radical on interior map 7): charge and radical land on SEPARATE fragments, so NEITHER product is the butadiene RADICAL CATION the book draws (products a/b carry +. on ONE fragment), and the interior 2-position placement gives high-energy vinyl-type ions rather than the resonance-stabilized allylic distonic radical cation. The record instead encodes the book faithfully as the R=vinyl instance of the verified charge-retention retro-DA (same step patterns and atom numbering as IMS4-EQ4.31).
